standard.name: Standard
standard.desc: Host your videos directly on the platform. More quality, more control.

q1.q: What if the original URL stops existing?
q1.a: No problem. The tattooed QR always points to your permanent identifier on Dynamic Tattoos. If the external URL dies, enter the dashboard and redirect it. The tattoo keeps working.

q2.q: How long does a tattooed QR last on skin?
q2.a: With quality ink and a skilled artist, like any fine tattoo: decades. We use error correction (level H) to tolerate touch-ups, scarring and aging.

q3.a: Yes, anytime. Your QR will keep working in static redirect mode (the last saved URL). To keep changing the destination, simply reactivate.

q4.q: Does it work on the wrist?
q4.a: It works, but curvature can affect readability. We recommend flat areas: inner forearm, outer biceps, calf or chest.

q5.q: Do I need to be a professional tattoo artist?
q5.a: No, but we recommend one experienced in fine lines. We send a technical guide and a stencil to your studio.
